subject: Arte
description_pt: Reconhecer e analisar a influência de distintas matrizes estéticas e culturais das artes visuais nas manifestações artísticas das culturas locais, regionais e nacionais.

components.description_pt: Reconhecer tradições estéticas e culturais que influenciaram expressões de artes visuais locais
components.description_en: Recognize aesthetic and cultural traditions that have influenced local visual arts expressions
components.cc_component_description: Identify cultural elements in fables and folktales from diverse traditions

components.description_pt: Analisar como tradições culturais distintas moldam expressões artísticas em uma comunidade dada
components.description_en: Analyze how distinct cultural traditions shape artistic expressions in a given community
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how a specific cultural experience shapes meaning in a world literature text

components.description_pt: Comparar expressões de artes visuais de diferentes tradições culturais presentes na cultura brasileira
components.description_en: Compare visual arts expressions from different cultural traditions present in Brazilian culture
components.cc_component_description: Compare the treatment of similar themes across stories or myths from different cultures

cc_matches.description: Analyze a particular point of view or cultural experience reflected in a work of literature from outside the United States, drawing on a wide reading of world literature.

Compare and contrast the treatment of similar themes and topics (e.g., opposition of good and evil) and patterns of events (e.g., the quest) in stories, myths, and traditional literature from different cultures.
Recount stories, including fables and folktales from diverse cultures, and determine their central message, lesson, or moral.
